title: Parking Past-Due Carry in Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Notices: Collections Casebook
content:
**Rule.** For a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement drafted under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the parking past-due balance the parking notice amount carries is nothing where the catch-up amount on the notice history for the parking agreement's oldest unpaid due date is at least the parking past-due balance left after the in-flight parking draft; that past-due balance less the catch-up amount where a smaller catch-up amount is on record; and otherwise the whole parking past-due balance left after the in-flight parking draft.

**What is read.** The catch-up amount on record is the total of the amounts stated on varying-amount notices on the authorization's notice history whose due date is the parking agreement's oldest unpaid due date (the date it has been delinquent since). The parking past-due balance left after the in-flight parking draft is the parking balance due on the handling date less the amount the in-flight parking draft counts at, never below nothing.

**Condition, judgement, result.**

- *Condition:* catch-up amount on record for the oldest unpaid due date of $140.00; past-due balance left $140.00. *Judgement:* at least the balance. *Result:* nothing carried.
- *Condition:* catch-up $85.00; past-due balance left $140.00. *Judgement:* smaller amount on record. *Result:* $55.00 carried.
- *Condition:* no varying-amount notice for the oldest unpaid due date (one exists for the next due date only); past-due balance left $140.00. *Judgement:* nothing on record for that due date. *Result:* $140.00 carried.
- *Condition:* catch-up $200.00; past-due balance left $140.00. *Judgement:* above the balance. *Result:* nothing carried.

(All figures hypothetical.)
